instruction: Single Zone Office Shoebox. Start from a blank OpenStudio model. There are no init_file inputs and no local reference images for this task. Use OpenStudio GUI operations, measures, scripts, or API calls to create a single-story office shoebox model and save the required outputs as /home/user/Desktop/result.osm and /home/user/Desktop/kpis.json. Every required output must be a valid, non-empty file at the stated Desktop path. The final model requirements are: - the result.osm model contains exactly 1 OS:Building, 1 OS:BuildingStory, 1 OS:Space, and 1 OS:ThermalZone; - the single OS:Space references the single OS:BuildingStory, references the single OS:ThermalZone, and has Part of Total Floor Area set to Yes; - the model has exactly 6 OS:Surface objects: 1 Floor surface, 1 RoofCeiling surface, and 4 Wall surfaces with Outside Boundary Condition set to Outdoors; - the surface geometry forms a rectangular box with X span 12.00 m, Y span 8.00 m, and Z span 3.60 m, each with tolerance +/-0.05 m; - the floor surface area is 96.00 m2 with tolerance +/-0.50 m2; - the sum of the 4 exterior wall gross areas is 144.00 m2 with tolerance +/-0.50 m2; - the model has exactly 2 window subsurfaces whose Sub Surface Type is FixedWindow, OperableWindow, GlassDoor, or Skylight; - the south facade is the exterior wall with the lowest world-coordinate center Y value, and its total window area is 17.28 m2 with tolerance +/-0.50 m2; - the east facade is the exterior wall with the highest world-coordinate center X value, and its total window area is 11.52 m2 with tolerance +/-0.50 m2; - the north facade and west facade have total window area no greater than 0.05 m2 each; - the south window-to-wall ratio is 0.40 with tolerance +/-0.03, and the east window-to-wall ratio is 0.40 with tolerance +/-0.03; - each window has minimum vertex Z equal to 0.90 m with tolerance +/-0.05 m; - the model contains at least one OS:DefaultConstructionSet and the single OS:Building references a default construction set; - the model contains exactly 1 OS:ZoneHVAC:IdealLoadsAirSystem, exactly 1 OS:ZoneHVAC:EquipmentList, and the equipment list references both the single OS:ThermalZone and the ideal loads system; - the model contains exactly 1 OS:ThermostatSetpoint:DualSetpoint referenced by the single OS:ThermalZone; - the thermostat heating schedule is an OS:Schedule:Constant with value 21.00 C with tolerance +/-0.25 C, and the cooling schedule is an OS:Schedule:Constant with value 24.00 C with tolerance +/-0.25 C; - the ideal loads availability schedule is an OS:Schedule:Constant with value 1 Prepare the required supporting files so that the kpis.json file contains floor_area_m2, exterior_wall_area_m2, south_window_area_m2, and east_window_area_m2 values matching the evaluator-computed model metrics with tolerance max(0.10, 1%). Details not named here may vary, including object handles, GUIDs, incidental metadata, construction names, material definitions, and serializer ordering, as long as the required OpenStudio objects, geometry, relationships, and output data are correct. [Software] Launch the OpenStudio GUI with `OpenStudioApp` from a terminal (PATH or full path to the binary).
